name: agent-relevance-evaluator-benchmark
purpose: Starter benchmark for validating an Input-Output relevance evaluator

input.description: 用户输入、问题或任务描述

output.description: LLM / Agent 针对 input 生成的输出

label.description: 相关性标签：1=相关，0=不相关

sample_type.description: positive=相关样本；strong_negative=明显不相关样本；hard_negative=与输入主题相关但没有真正回答用户需求的样本

construction.description: 样本构造方式，说明该样本是如何生成或处理得到的

source_dataset.description: 原始数据集来源，用于记录样本的来源和数据溯源信息

limitations: This is a silver benchmark: negative labels were constructed by pairing outputs, not independently human-annotated. Do not use it alone to claim evaluator accuracy.
